name: 34236 · Sarasota, FL
findings: ZIP 34236 (Sarasota) has 270 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34236 (Sarasota) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 34236 (Sarasota) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
